# Original private script output HTTP corpus

endpoint-script-output-http.json is an unchanged copy of .endpoint-tools/script-output-20261021/original-output-c.json; 32930 bytes; SHA-256 32a4fdb34470c5f6f59e5537d2c9f16f17a0a8c393d9c6751b00224b76db64ff. It contains ten original native-output cases submitted through the actual credential-only PHP upload route and downloaded through the separately authorised staff content route. The returned content bytes are Base64-preserved exactly, alongside the original signed dispatch, accepted result, upload header and immutable upload acknowledgement. All content and identities are synthetic.

The original input is .endpoint-tools/script-cancellation-20261021/native-output-b.json. It comes from the bounded native collector without an interpreter/process. Cases: empty_zero, discard_zero, exact_limit, overflow, scalar_boundary, unicode, invalid_sequence, unfinished, replacement_budget, control_and_nul. Go TestScriptOriginalHTTPOutput verifies the original signed dispatch, reconstructs each upload header from downloaded bytes, validates the exact HTTP receipt, preserves historical acknowledgement after retention expiry and rejects altered content, identities, metadata/types and receipt times. This does not prove a connected native HTTP client, local spool or installed execution.

Final focused native C passed 9 tests/304 assertions, with all 96 source/fixture pins unchanged (537.949s wrapper). It checks canonical mixed-case attempt recovery, the full65536-byte budget, definite nonentry denial and all output regressions. Broad native B passed88 tests/1108 assertions with96 pins frozen (603.105s wrapper);94 pins remain unchanged with only the command service and catalogue test overlaid for canonical receipt identity and added boundary coverage. Ten original Go collector cases traverse actual PHP upload and authorised download routes and are consumed again by Go: empty/zero-budget, truncation, scalar boundaries, Unicode, invalid-sequence replacement, incomplete UTF-8 replacement, controls and NUL. Dedicated cases cover private grant/MFA/ownership/Site checks, malformed bodies/headers/origins, late/revoked/foreign identity, damaged ciphertext/receipts/results, fixed retention, bounded purge and immutable recovery after erasure.

Native A was interrupted after 253.902s to correct a multi-case test fixture that reused one synthetic credential across different enrolled agents. Only the test fixture changed A→B; the later C correction makes output acknowledgements and reads use the canonical stored attempt ID. A is unaccepted test evidence. Separate PHP checks passed 15/419, comprising non-connecting contract/schema checks and isolated SQLite permission-backfill checks. Final Go A passed 17 top-level tests/146 subtests, none skipped, with all 16 source pins and 7 original producer inputs unchanged. Vet and Windows ARM64 compilation passed; ARM64 was not executed. Fresh native output exactly matches the original corpus consumed by PHP. Twelve PHP syntax checks, scoped style and diff passed. All three exact test schemas are absent with zero tables/connections; all ten recorded native/Go/Node runners are terminal. The previous cancellation package retains 83 unchanged pins with seven declared overlays. Exact original HTTP corpus/provenance is in tests/fixtures/endpoint-script-output-http.*; separate epochs, input hashes and cleanup are in .endpoint-tools/script-output-20261021/final-check.json.
